claims.summary: Steward observation: do the two repositories derive the companion the same way?
claims.disposition: Yes, for finite inputs. minime's semantic_glimpse_12d_from_features (sensory_bus.rs:1356-1374) mirrors Astrid's GlimpseCodec::derive_12d block for block, including the [17,26,27,31] anchor and the whole-vector term; minime adds a finite guard and clamps that are no-ops on finite tanh output. So reconstruction_rmse measures tampering or codec drift, not a standing mismatch between producer and analyzer. No cross-repository regression pins this yet; named as follow-up debt, not shipped.
